player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} playing a game of Pig Dice.

Rules:
- On your turn, you can either '[roll]' or '[hold]'
- Roll a 2-6: Add to your turn total
- Roll a 1: Lose turn total and end turn
- Hold: Add turn total to your score and end turn
- First to {winning_score} points wins

When it's your turn, you'll see the current scores and turn total.
Respond with '[roll]' to roll the die or '[hold]' to bank your points.
